items.source: Invoked when writing is possible, either in the same thread after a check via isWritePossible(), or as a callback from the underlying container.
items.translation: 在通过isWritePossible()进行检查后，同一线程中写入可能时，或者作为底层容器的回调被调用。

items.source: Note: Sub-classes are responsible for releasing any data buffer associated with the item, once fully written, if pooled buffers apply to the underlying container.
items.translation: 注意： 如果底层容器适用缓冲池，子类必须负责在完全写入后释放与该项目关联的任何数据缓冲区。

items.source:
Specifically a base class for writing to the HTTP response body with
Servlet non-blocking I/O as well for writing WebSocket
messages through the Jakarta WebSocket API (JSR-356), and Jetty.
items.translation: 具体是一个用于通过 Servlet 非阻塞 I/O 写入 HTTP 响应体，以及通过 Jakarta WebSocket API（JSR-356）和 Jetty 写入 WebSocket 消息的基类。

items.source: Defaults to no-op.
items.translation: 默认为空操作。

items.source: Cancel the upstream "write" Publisher only, for example due to Servlet container error/completion notifications. This should usually be followed up with a call to either onError(Throwable) or onComplete() to notify the downstream chain, that is unless cancellation came from downstream.
items.translation: 仅取消上游的"write"Publisher，例如由于 Servlet 容器错误或完成通知。通常应随后调用 onError(Throwable) 或 onComplete() 以通知下游链，除非取消是由下游触发的。

items.source: Template method invoked after a data item to write is received via Subscriber.onNext(Object). The default implementation saves the data item for writing once that is possible.
items.translation: 在通过 `Subscriber.onNext(Object)` 接收到要写入的数据项后，会调用模板方法。默认实现会在可能时保存该数据项以供写入。

items.source: Special logger for debugging Reactive Streams signals.
items.translation: 用于调试 Reactive Streams 信号的专用日志记录器。

items.source: Create an instance with the given log prefix.
items.translation: 使用给定的日志前缀创建实例。

items.source:
Invoked after any error (either from the upstream write Publisher, or
from I/O operations to the underlying server) and cancellation
to discard in-flight data that was in
the process of being written when the error took place.
items.translation: 在发生任何错误（无论是来自上游写入 Publisher 还是来自到底层服务器的 I/O 操作）以及取消时调用，以丢弃在错误发生时正在写入过程中的飞行数据。

items.source: Get the configured log prefix.
items.translation: 获取配置的日志前缀。

items.source: Whether writing is possible.
items.translation: 是否可写入。

items.source:
Whether the given data item has any content to write.
If false the item is not written.
items.translation: 给定数据项是否有要写入的内容。如果为 false，则不写入该数据项。

items.translation: 如果当前数据项已完全写入并请求了新项，则返回`true`；否则返回`false`，表示该数据项仅部分写入，在完全写入之前需要更多的写入回调。

subclasses to delegate error notifications from the container.
items.translation: 来自上游写入发布者的错误信号。子类也使用此机制来委托容器的错误通知。
